Ranchi: CM Hemant Soren ne bataee vajah kyon sadgi se is bar manae gaya jharkhand sthapna divas? | Jharkhand
Jharkhand sthapna divas ke avsar par is bar karyakram sadgi ke sath aayojit kiya gaya. mukhyamantri hemant soren ne iski vajah batate hue kaha ki aakhir kyon is bar sthapna divas ka aayojan sade tarike se kiya gaya. sunie mukhyamantri hemant soren ka pura bayana.
